map.在 2~36 进制之间任意转换数字，支持二进制、八进制、十进制、十六进制。: Convert numbers between any bases from 2 to 36, including binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal.
map.在二进制、八进制、十进制、十六进制等进位制之间转换。: Converts between positional number systems such as binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal.
map.：二(2)、八(8)、十(10)、十六(16)，也支持自定义 2–36 进制。: : binary (2), octal (8), decimal (10) and hexadecimal (16); custom bases from 2 to 36 are also supported.
map.：任意进制转十进制用按权展开求和；十进制转目标进制用除基取余（小数部分乘基取整）: : converting any base to decimal uses positional expansion and summation; converting decimal to the target base uses repeated division (and multiplication for the fractional part).
map.：十六进制用 A–F 表示 10–15；超过 36 进制需自定义符号集。: : hexadecimal uses A–F for 10–15; bases above 36 need a custom symbol set.
map.：负数单独处理符号位；小数转换存在精度限制，可能得到近似值。: : negative numbers handle the sign separately; fractional conversion is limited by precision and may yield an approximation.
map.进制 2~36 均可使用，超过 10 的数位用 A~Z 表示。: Bases 2 to 36 are all accepted; digits above 10 use A–Z.
map.输入十六进制时可带或不带 0x 前缀。: Hexadecimal input may be written with or without the 0x prefix.
map.结果包含二进制、八进制、十进制、十六进制及用户指定目标进制的对照。: The result compares binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal alongside the target base you specify.
map.开发调试中 10/16/2/8 互转。: Converting between 10/16/2/8 while developing and debugging.
map.读内存地址与掩码：把 0xFF 与十进制 255 互相转换，或用掩码 0b111: Reading memory addresses and masks: converting 0xFF and decimal 255 back and forth, or using the mask 0b11110000 to extract the high nibble of a byte, is everyday work in bit manipulation and protocol parsing.
map.整数部分用「除基取余、逆序排列」，小数部分用「乘基取整、顺序排列」。注意二进制无: The integer part uses "divide by the base, collect the remainders, reverse the order" and the fractional part uses "multiply by the base, collect the integer parts, keep the order". Note that binary cannot represent decimal 0.1 exactly (just as decimal cannot represent 1/3 exactly), so converting a float to binary often produces an infinite repeating fraction — this is exactly why 0.1 + 0.2 ≠ 0.3 in many languages.
